paragraphs.text: There is an essential privacy boundary here: connecting financial records or private conversations to ChatGPT does not automatically give OpenAI’s investment decision-makers access to them. That would require a separate, explicit authorization and appropriate controls.
But the technology could make such a voluntary exchange remarkably efficient.
There’s an even bigger economic possibility
An AI provider could potentially become a customer’s:
Compute financier: Extending resources before the business generates revenue.
Commercial partner: Facilitating introductions and distribution.
Capital provider: Offering financing based on verified business performance.
Strategic investor: Acquiring equity in successful customer-created businesses.
Long-term beneficiary: Sharing in the success of companies its ecosystem helped create.
The resulting commercial relationship could become substantially more valuable to both parties than subscription revenue alone.
And importantly, your emphasis on spending matters.

A customer who has contributed $30,000 over five years, maintained a reliable payment history, and built a successful company using the platform has demonstrated several economically meaningful forms of commitment.
That’s a significant relationship asset, even though it doesn’t independently establish investment merit.
